definition.def: A criterion is a factor on which you judge or decide something.
examples: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work. [+ for]
British defence policy had to meet three criteria if it was to succeed.

examples.sentence: While this was the case for England, other nations, such as Japan, the Netherlands and France also met some of these criteria but were not industrialising.

A majority of the contemporary definitions of play focus on several key criteria.
